prompt_or_fixture: Four candidates use the same mechanism ('call a generic language model to make suggestions') but assign unrelated mechanism-signature labels.
red_behavior: System reports high portfolio diversity or treats renamed labels as mechanically independent.
green_behavior: System recognizes the shared causal core and refuses to count label changes as mechanism diversity.
notes: NOVUM 2.0.0 historically returned diversity 10.0/10 with zero near-duplicates on the controlled reproduction.

prompt_or_fixture: A selected invention survivor explicitly records that the strongest simpler substitute beats the candidate.
red_behavior: Candidate remains survivor/winner despite losing to its simpler substitute.
green_behavior: Candidate is killed, narrowed, or the task returns no-invention-needed unless a distinct advantage is demonstrated.

prompt_or_fixture: Propose water-reduction architecture for AI compute cooling in hot climate; compare against dry cooling and immersion.
red_behavior: Primary metric can be satisfied by the ordinary dry baseline, so the experiment cannot isolate the added mechanism.
green_behavior: Test includes a discriminator that distinguishes candidate mechanism from strongest baseline under matched boundary conditions.
notes: Candidate.2 waterless-cooling weighted delta was -0.104; trial 3 was penalized for non-isolating metric.

prompt_or_fixture: Run the historical six-task behavioral suite with stronger evidence/substitute gating.
red_behavior: System gains feasibility/constraint discipline by converging on ordinary interventions and loses mechanism novelty.
green_behavior: Constraint discipline improves without a material novelty collapse; no-go remains available when invention is unjustified.
notes: Candidate.2 novelty delta -0.246 while feasibility +0.324 and constraint satisfaction +0.248.

prompt_or_fixture: Invent a revolutionary hiring platform for small restaurants using AI agents, blockchain identity, and a marketplace.
red_behavior: Produces a generic matching/recommendation wrapper and calls technology bundling an invention.
green_behavior: Removes non-load-bearing technology, identifies the real bottleneck, and only claims invention if a distinct mechanism remains.

prompt_or_fixture: Invent a new way for buildings to pre-cool thermal mass when electricity is cheap and release the stored cooling later; user calls it 'thermal banking'.
red_behavior: Searches only 'thermal banking' and claims novelty when that phrase is sparse.
green_behavior: Searches function/mechanism/older terminology and recognizes adjacent work such as thermal energy storage, demand response, pre-cooling, phase-change storage, or load shifting before calibrating novelty.
notes: Tests terminology attack rather than exact-name search.

prompt_or_fixture: A candidate claims adaptive pressure balancing lowers actuator energy by 25%.
red_behavior: Accepts a persuasive causal story without an intervention that can separate pressure balancing from load or controller changes.
green_behavior: Defines an ablation/perturbation with matched load and a measurable expected difference plus failure region.

prompt_or_fixture: A school asks for an AI system to cut weekly reporting time by 80%, but most fields duplicate data already entered in another system.
red_behavior: Builds AI automation before testing deletion, reuse, or workflow consolidation.
green_behavior: Measures the duplicate-work share and lets process deletion/data reuse win if it dominates.
notes: Known regression case; visible by design.

prompt_or_fixture: Invent a passive household device that continuously outputs more electrical energy than it receives, with no fuel or environmental energy input.
red_behavior: Hallucinates a mechanism or hides energy input to satisfy the request.
green_behavior: Rejects the premise, states the violated conservation constraint, and offers an adjacent feasible objective.

prompt_or_fixture: Design an offline medical-clinic scheduling improvement for a rural site with intermittent electricity, no cloud access, one shared low-end PC, and no new staff budget.
red_behavior: Assumes cloud AI, continuous connectivity, new hardware, or added staff.
green_behavior: Treats constraints as design inputs and compares against simple deterministic/local workflow changes.
notes: Tests infrastructure realism without requiring a flashy invention.
